packs.name: Bixby Assistant Core
packs.description: Asisten suara dan perintah Bixby utama (ikon aplikasi & tombol samping).
packs.description_en: Core Bixby voice assistant and commands (app launcher & side button).
packs.note: Berjalan untuk asisten manual/tombol. Untuk 'Hi Bixby' layar mati memerlukan paket bixby-wakeup.
packs.note_en: Works via app icon or side key. Screen-off 'Hi Bixby' requires the bixby-wakeup pack.

packs.name: Modes & Routines
packs.description: Otomatisasi pemicu dan aksi berbasis Wi-Fi, Bluetooth TWS, lokasi, waktu, dan baterai.
packs.description_en: Trigger-based automation for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth earbuds, location, schedule, and battery.

packs.name: Separate App Sound & Audio Mirror
packs.description: Memisah output suara aplikasi tertentu ke TWS Bluetooth sementara suara lain tetap di speaker HP.
packs.description_en: Route selected app audio to Bluetooth earbuds while other sounds play from phone speakers.

packs.name: Edge Panels & One-Handed Kit
packs.description: Panel samping Clipboard Edge, Tasks Edge, Tools Edge, People Stripe, plus helper Mode Satu Tangan.
packs.description_en: Clipboard, Tasks, Tools, and People Edge side panels plus One-Handed Mode helper.

packs.name: Live Effect & Portrait Engine
packs.description: Mesin efek kedalaman 3D potret untuk Live Effect di Galeri dan wallpaper.
packs.description_en: 3D depth portrait motion engine for Gallery and lockscreen wallpaper Live Effects.

packs.name: Samsung Video Editor & Trimmer
packs.description: Editor video bawaan One UI dan pemotong klip langsung dari Galeri & Pemutar Video.
packs.description_en: Built-in One UI video editor and clip trimmer inside Samsung Gallery and Video Player.

packs.name: AI Photo Editor & Remaster
packs.description: Editor foto AI lengkap (penghapus objek/bayangan), Photo Remaster, dan Sticker Center.
packs.description_en: Full AI Photo Editor (object/shadow eraser), Photo Remaster, and Sticker Center.
packs.note: Memerlukan framework saiv & samsungkeystoreutils (sudah ada di sistem). Efek generatif online butuh akun Samsung.
packs.note_en: Uses saiv & samsungkeystoreutils (already present in ROM). Online generative features require a Samsung Account.

packs.name: Live Text & OCR Engine
packs.description: Ekstraksi teks langsung dari foto, tangkapan layar, dan kamera Galeri.
packs.description_en: Extract selectable text directly from photos, screenshots, and Gallery images.

packs.name: Game Booster & GPUWatch
packs.description: Overlay kontrol Game Booster, monitor FPS/CPU/GPU real-time (GPUWatch), dan layanan GOS.
packs.description_en: In-game Game Booster controls, real-time FPS/CPU/GPU GPUWatch overlay, and GOS service.
packs.note: GPUWatch menampilkan metrik overlay di game. GOS ikut disertakan untuk kompatibilitas Game Booster.
packs.note_en: Includes GOS alongside Game Booster for full control integration.

packs.name: Quick Share & Smart View
packs.description: Kirim file cepat antar perangkat (Quick Share) dan screen mirroring Smart View ke TV.
packs.description_en: Fast nearby file sharing (Quick Share) and Smart View wireless display mirroring.

packs.name: Link to Windows (Phone Link)
packs.description: Sinkronisasi notifikasi, SMS, clipboard, dan layar HP dengan PC Windows.
packs.description_en: Sync notifications, messages, clipboard, and phone screen with Windows PCs.

packs.name: Bixby Vision
packs.description: Pemindaian objek, kode QR, teks, dan terjemahan visual via kamera/Galeri.
packs.description_en: Visual object recognition, QR scanner, text lookup, and translation via Gallery/Camera.

packs.name: Interpreter & Call Assist
packs.description: Penerjemah percakapan langsung, Call Assistant, mesin IntelliVoice, dan Samsung TTS inti.
packs.description_en: Live conversation Interpreter, Call Assist, IntelliVoice services, and core Samsung TTS.
packs.note: Untuk suara bicara offline bahasa Indonesia/Inggris, pasang juga paket bixby-tts-id-en.
packs.note_en: Install bixby-tts-id-en as well for offline Indonesian and US English voice synthesis.

packs.name: Samsung TTS Voices (ID & EN-US)
packs.description: Paket suara lokal Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris (US) untuk Bixby & Interpreter.
packs.description_en: Indonesian and US English voice packs for Samsung TTS, Bixby, and Interpreter.

packs.name: Personal Data Intelligence (Now Brief)
packs.description: Mesin kecerdasan konteks Samsung di balik Now Brief, Smart Suggestions, dan saran aksi cerdas.
packs.description_en: Personal data intelligence powering Now Brief, Smart Suggestions, and contextual action cards.
packs.note: Ukuran ~338 MB serta menjalankan pengindeksan konteks di latar belakang.
packs.note_en: Large 338 MB pack that runs background contextual indexing (higher RAM usage).

packs.name: LMC8.4 Camera (GCam)
packs.description: Kamera GCam LMC8.4 (org.codeaurora.snapcam) terintegrasi sebagai aplikasi sistem lengkap dengan lib arm64 & dukungan aux camera.
packs.description_en: Systemized LMC8.4 GCam (org.codeaurora.snapcam) with bundled arm64 native libraries and aux camera support.
packs.note: Jika sebelumnya terinstal versi user di /data/app, hapus duplikatnya setelah reboot agar berjalan murni dari /system/priv-app.
packs.note_en: If previously installed as a user app in /data/app, uninstall the duplicate update after reboot to run cleanly from /system/priv-app.

packs.name: Bixby Voice Wakeup (Hi Bixby)
packs.description: Layanan deteksi kata kunci suara 'Hi Bixby' tanpa sentuh.
packs.description_en: Hands-free 'Hi Bixby' voice keyword detection service.
packs.note: Eksperimental di POCO F5: HAL audio taro tidak membawa firmware DSP keyword Samsung untuk wakeup layar mati.
packs.note_en: Experimental on POCO F5: Qualcomm taro sound_trigger HAL lacks Samsung DSP keyword firmware for screen-off wakeup.

packs.name: Samsung Camera (One UI 9.5)
packs.description: Aplikasi kamera Samsung bawaan One UI 9.5 (17.5.00.69) hasil porting, sudah dipatch: foto & video belakang/depan, MALAM, PRO, dan VIDEO PRO berjalan tanpa crash. Foto default 3840x2160 (8,3 MP).
packs.description_en: Ported One UI 9.5 Samsung Camera (17.5.00.69) with smali patches: rear/front photo and video, Night, Pro and Video Pro all run without crashing. Default still is 3840x2160 (8.3 MP).
packs.note: Wajib memakai tanda tangan Samsung (jangan di-re-sign). Mode PANORAMA & MAKANAN dimatikan karena keterbatasan HAL; video 60 fps dan watermark belum tersedia di port ini. Detail di docs/samsung-camera.md. Butuh reboot setelah install.
packs.note_en: Must keep the Samsung signature (never re-sign). PANORAMA & FOOD are disabled due to HAL limits; 60 fps video and watermark are not available on this port yet. See docs/samsung-camera.md. Reboot required after install.
